title: Changes in effectiveness and safety in patients with Lennox-Gastaut syndrome transitioning from the fenfluramine randomized controlled trial to open-label extension study.
study_design: Post hoc analysis of a randomized controlled trial and open-label extension study
justification: This study analyzes data from patients transitioning from a randomized controlled trial to an open-label extension, which is characteristic of a cohort study design. It does not represent a new randomized controlled trial but rather an analysis of outcomes based on treatment received.

title: Retrospective evaluation of caregiver-administered buccal midazolam for pediatric status epilepticus in a regional core hospital in Japan.
justification: This study is a retrospective evaluation of a cohort of pediatric patients who received buccal midazolam for status epilepticus, making it a cohort study. The sample size of 38 episodes is explicitly mentioned.

title: Cumulative electroconvulsive therapy sessions and focal epilepsy: A nationwide cohort study in Japan.
justification: This study is a retrospective cohort study examining the association between cumulative ECT sessions and the development of focal epilepsy in a large patient population. It does not involve randomization or a control group, which aligns it with Level 3 evidence.

title: Ketogenic diet for pediatric drug-resistant epilepsy: sleep, children's psychosocial functioning, and maternal mental health.
justification: The study follows a group of children with drug-resistant epilepsy over time to assess the effects of the ketogenic diet on various outcomes, which fits the definition of a cohort study. It does not involve randomization, thus it is not classified as an RCT.

title: Focal epilepsy expands the phenotype of FUS-associated amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
cebm_label: Case report, case series, expert opinion, animal study, or in-vitro study
justification: This study presents a single case of a patient with FUS-ALS and comorbid focal epilepsy, which is characteristic of a case report. There is no mention of a larger sample size or comparative analysis.

title: Electroclinical and behavioral outcomes of add-on ethosuximide in children with developmental and epileptic encephalopathy with spike-wave activation in sleep (D/EE-SWAS): A prospective observational study.
justification: This study is a prospective observational cohort study evaluating the outcomes of add-on ethosuximide in children with D/EE-SWAS, which fits the criteria for a Level 3 evidence study design.

title: Surgical strategies after failed hemispheric disconnection surgery: A systematic review and individual-patient data analysis.
cebm_label: Systematic review or meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials (RCTs)
study_design: Systematic review and individual-patient data analysis
sample_size: n=169 (151 for RHS, 9 for LITT, 9 for VNS)
justification: This study is a systematic review that includes individual-patient data analysis, synthesizing outcomes from multiple studies, which qualifies it for Level 1 evidence. It provides comprehensive insights into surgical outcomes after failed hemispheric disconnection surgery.
